hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '^git commit'; then pdfs=$(git -C /Users/matt/Repos/VibrationofAwesome diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -i '\.pdf$' || true); if [ -n "$pdfs" ]; then while IFS= read -r f; do full="/Users/matt/Repos/VibrationofAwesome/$f"; exiftool -Author='Matt EarthStar' -Creator='Vibration of Awesome' -Producer='Vibration of Awesome' -overwrite_original "$full" 2>/dev/null && git -C /Users/matt/Repos/VibrationofAwesome add "$f" 2>/dev/null; done <<< "$pdfs"; fi; fi
